featured_reviews.review_text: This place used to be the best print shop in the area but lately it's been consistently more expensive than many better competitive places in recent years. Terrible customer service too. Everyone has an inflated ego for some reason. Earlier they used to work with you and consult with the designer to achieve their expected output. Now they just talk rude and give you a terrible output even after specifically requesting a specific type of finish. And charge you a bomb for it too. They used to be my go to place as a budding designer in school for all my print needs. Super disappointed :(

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Karnad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrible experience today. I had asked to make a smart card and paid full money. i was asked to come after 24 hours. i went to collect after 30 hours but it was not ready and the staff was extremely rude. They asked to come later. When i said it was not possible,  one staff asked to me take the money back. When I asked them to give the phone number of the owner, they denied it.
After I started arguing and a few people gathered, one lady came up from inside and said she will get it done in 15 minutes. And lo behold! they did it in 15 minutes. So what was the attitude earlier all about?
I will never use their services again.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: Very horrible support staff. Beware of this guys because they charge you for everything. Ridiculous staff behavior. Asked for 6" * 8" photo prints for which I was told 20 Rs per photo. When the prints came out it came on A4 paper. Now they charge 5 Rs extra per photo to cut from A4 to 6" * 8". So each photo instead of costing 20 Rs now costs 25 Rs. By this logic if you ask them to print 500 visiting cards, they will charge 5 rs for cutting one visiting card??? Then I asked them to give me cutter so I can cut it myself, to which the guy ridicules saying it will take 20 minutes just to give a normal Cutter. Worst service experience ever. Avoid this place if possible.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
My go to place for any printing requirement.

Good quality prints and quick service.
Overall staff is polite.

Mr. Shardul is patient and efficient with his work.
Shankar Bhai, takes prints and does cutting patiently. No compromise on quality.

featured_reviews.name: krutik panchal
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst customer service experienced. Print was to be taken on letter head and this guy gave me a print which was upside down. On asking him as in why this mistake happened and I had only one letter head so this will wadlste my time, he had the audacity to blame cusomer for the same. He says I should have got 2 letter heads as this is machine fault. Person doing this work day in and out is aware of how to put paper for print. Worst part is that instaed of apologising the owner blamed customer for not carrying extra letter head. Will never opt services from this shop.
